title: USTC研究 Interim Analysis设计与Futility Interim建议

background.text: USTC研究基于TRACE3随机试验数据：tenecteplase组90天mRS 0-2为43.6%，标准医疗组为33.4%（差异10.2%）。双侧alpha 0.05、80%把握度、1:1分配，估算每组357例，考虑10%失访后每组397例，最终总样本量794例。
background.quote:
Based on the TRACE3 randomized trial, the 90-day mRS 0 to 2 in patients treated with tenecteplase was 43.6% compared to 33.4% in the standard medical care group (difference=10.2%).

With two-sided alpha of 0.05, power of 80%, and 1:1 allocation, the sample size is estimated to be 357 patients per arm. After accounting for 10% attrition or loss to follow-up, there would be 397 patients per arm. The final total sample size was 794 patients.

background.text: USTC Power重新评估：Observed case场景（N=714）把握度80.0%，最小可检测cOR差异7%；Imputed case场景（N=794）把握度84.4%，最小可检测cOR差异6.8%。
background.quote: Scenario: Observed case | N: 714 | Power: 80.0% | Min. detectable cOR: 7%
Scenario: Imputed case | N: 794 | Power: 84.4% | Min. detectable cOR: 6.8%

background.text: 原方案（Slide 6）入组计划：第9月累计217例（44%）设Futility Interim，第10月累计248例（50%）设Futility Interim，第13月累计341例（69%）设Efficacy Interim，第16月累计434例（88%）设Efficacy Interim，第18月累计496例（100%）为Last patient in，每月入组31例。
background.quote: 月数: 9 | 每月入组例数: 31 | 累计入组: 217 | 累计入组%: 44% | Note: Futility Interim

background.text: 原方案信息分数50%时：interim把握度16.8%，最小可检测差异18.5%，总体把握度84.3%，最终最小可检测差异9.0%；信息分数66.7%时：interim把握度46.4%，最小可检测差异13.9%，总体把握度82.6%。
background.quote: Infor. fraction: 50% | Power for interim: 16.8% | Min. Detectable diff. - interim: 18.5% | Overall power: 84.3% | Min. Detectable diff. - final: 9.0%

background.text: 修订方案（Slide 8）入组计划：第1月10例（1%）First patient in，第12月累计350例（44%）设Futility Interim，第13月累计387例（49%）设Futility Interim，第18月累计572例（72%）设Efficacy Interim，第21月累计683例（86%）设Efficacy Interim，第24月累计794例（100%）为Last patient in，每月入组37例。
background.quote: 月数: 12 | 每月入组例数: 37 | 累计入组: 350 | 累计入组%: 44% | Note: Futility Interim

background.text: 修订方案信息分数50%时：interim把握度19.3%，最小可检测差异14.1%，总体把握度84.7%，最终最小可检测差异6.8%；信息分数66.7%时：interim把握度46.1%，最小可检测差异10.6%，总体把握度84.3%。
background.quote: Infor. fraction: 50% | Power for interim: 19.3% | Min. Detectable diff. - interim: 14.1% | Overall power: 84.7% | Min. Detectable diff. - final: 6.8%

decision.text: USTC研究不推荐Futility Interim，理由：治疗效果不确定性降低；小样本导致可靠性低；Efficacy Interim获益有限；研究者不接受基于低可靠性结果的早期停止（考虑审查方潜在质疑）。推荐设立DMC进行安全性和有效性评估。
decision.quote:
Futility interim is not recommended
There is less uncertainty on the treatment effect.
Small sample size result in low reliability.
Efficacy Interim benefits less
The investigator doesn’t accept early stop at interim considering low reliability result and potential challenge from reviewer.
DMC is recommended for safety and efficacy evaluation.
